title: In speech to Spanish parliament, pope demands respect for the dignity of all people
summary: In the first papal address to the Spanish legislature, the American pope said a "moral renewal" was necessary in legislatures and public life to ensure respect for the inherent dignity of all people.
contentText:
In the first papal address to the Spanish legislature, the American pope said a "moral renewal" was necessary in legislatures and public life to ensure respect for the inherent dignity of all people.

(Image credit: Yara Nardi/Reuters Pool via AP)
